questions.question: How did Elisha help the widow with only a jar of oil?
options: He sold it for a great price in town
An angel filled her empty storehouse
He turned the oil into pure silver
The oil multiplied to fill many jars
questions.answer: The oil multiplied to fill many jars

questions.question: What did Elisha do for the Shunammite woman's son?
options: Taught him the law of Moses
Gave him a fortune in gold
Healed him of a burning fever

questions.question: Elisha made a poisonous pot of stew safe to eat.
